messages:
Toni: quick async check-in — kernel digest for today (what I did / blockers / plan)
Toni: done: landed batch-slot fairness tweak (ensures small requests don't starve big ones). CI moved, no regressed tests.
Toni: done: added lightweight metric for slot-fill-ratio; emits histogram 'batch.slot_fill' to tracing.
Toni: blocker: still seeing an intermittent OOM in microbatch path when kv warmup + long seqs align. repro is rare locally.
Toni: plan: instrument a per-slot mem-guard and run 2x perf sweep on canary, then open a small hotfix if stable. pinging @Matt for review on the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/483
Matt: looking now. main question: does the fairness tweak change inter-batch latency distribution?
Toni: it nudges slot assignment order only when a slot is >70% empty for 2s. median unchanged, p95 improved slightly in my local run.
Matt: ok nice. re: OOM — can you paste the small repro snippet you used?
Toni: sure:
```bash
python -m bench.run --model gpt-medium --seq 2048 --concurrency 6 --batch 8 --kv-warmup 1
```
Toni: I also added a debug env var: RUNTIME_DEBUG_SLOT_DUMP=1 to capture slot shapes on failure.
Sarah: I can run the canary sweep in eu-west-1 later today. which commit should I point at?
Toni: use commit 9c1f2b7 on this branch (the PR has it). thanks Sarah.
Sarah: ack. will run two sweeps (with/without per-slot guard) and post summary. ETA ~3h.
Akhil: small note — if guard flips on, can we fallback to greedy single-slot packing instead of dropping? Could avoid tail latency spikes.
Toni: yeah plan is: if predicted mem > available -> try single-slot fallback, then if still failing return 429ish with reason 'slot-memory'.
Zoe: FYI I rebased the bench harness to record gpu-resident-bytes at each sample; should help correlate. will push patch to bench infra.
ci-bot: build/runtime-tests passed for 9c1f2b7 (job #4621) :white_check_mark:
Sarah: quick feed: first sweep (no guard) p50=11ms p95=86ms p99=210ms mem-peak=12.3GB on g4dn. second sweep (guard enabled) p50=12ms p95=78ms p99=170ms mem-peak=11.1GB.
Toni: thanks — that p99 drop looks promising. can you attach the slot_fill histograms? also any patterns on seq alignment?
Sarah: attaching gist shortly, but early look: most p99 cases align with 3+ long-seq requests starting within 40ms window.
Matt: if alignment is the issue maybe a tiny jitter before KV warmup start would mitigate without guard cost. tradeoff: slightly higher median.
Toni: noted — I'll try a 5-10ms jitter in the warmup path next.
Akhil: also adding to TODO: run synthetic with poisson arrivals to check real-world burst behavior.
Zoe: cool. ping me if you want the gpu metrics dashboard updated to include slot-level heatmap.
Toni: thanks team. will iterate on small hotfix + jitter, post results here. if Sarah's canary holds we'll merge the PR and enable guard by default behind a flag. :thumbsup:
Matt: LGTM on the plan. I'll do the PR review today.
Sarah: I'll post the full gist in ~2.5h.
ci-bot: benchmark/sweep completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/bench/2390004321/ (summary.json + traces)
Toni: awesome — that's all for me. short follow-ups: 1) review PR, 2) decide guard default after canary, 3) consider jitter if needed.
